entities.name: First Zionist Congress
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: First Zionist Congress, a political institution in Israel during Late Ottoman Palestine and Early Zionism (1882–1917). Grew from Ottoman and Nineteenth-Century Palestine. Led to the emergence of Theodor Herzl convenes the First Zionist Congress in Basel and Tel Aviv founded as the first modern Hebrew-speaking city.
